scenes.summary: Rumors of the canal's disturbances spread, leaving residents terrified to use water. Jing Hong, a panicked local briefs you and points to Li Heng, a Tianshi disciple for further investigation.

lines.text: I'll get some more offerings. Please... Just make it stop...
AAAHHH!!! No offense, no offense! By the old rites, begone, unseen ones!
Gah! You scared me! Thought those things were angry about the offerings again...
O-oh! You're ... asking about *the things* in the canals?
The water moves wrong. And the noises ... oh goodness the noises...
And — and the water glows green at night ... like drowned souls!
Right? Everyone's terrified. No one dares touch the water now!
They say a body fell in last month... Now it's not human anymore... *Shivers*
I've said too much! That Tianshi disciple over there, ⟦key|Li Heng⟧ ... he knows the dark waters better...
How do we use water with that ⟦key|filth⟧ causing chaos every day?

options: "Filth", you said. What does that mean?
That does sound a little suspicious...
This poses a clear threat to public water safety.

scenes.summary: Li Heng dismisses the rumors as superstition. To ease fears, he requests inspections at two canal sites.

lines.text: Readings stable, chem-levels nominal... Hm? Endministrator, you need me?
Ignore that nonsense. "Filth"? Superstition is the real pollutant.
I walk these canals twice a week. Never once seen anything "abnormal".
My bet? Someone's illegally breeding fin, caused a ruckus, and sparked wild rumors.
*Sigh* But the panic's real. People refusing to use water is a public health risk...
Perfect! You can start with the ⟦key|canals under Fangxing Avenue and near the Tianshi Bureau Academy⟧.

options: So, about the "filth" in the waters...
The locals said something about ... "movement" in the waters.

scenes.summary: After talking to Li Heng, he admits the devices are his prototypes that caused disturbances, but not the ones near HS.Swords. The worst disturbances are where he didn't deploy them... You decide to investigate further.

lines.text: Oh goodness it's real! There really is "filth" in the waters!
Just now...
My prototypes deployed for testing... Their signals just vanished! I went to retrieve them and... Gone.
Since when do canal sensors get "eaten"?! I signed up for tech, not predatory infrastructure!
Is this ... karma for mocking the water ghosts?! Are the drowned punishing my skepticism?!
Yeah! Where did you...
No way! These are eco-friendly silent models!
Oh, uh... It's damaged by water, so the motors and LEDs are malfunctioning. Seems like those lights and the sounds ... were caused by them ... ha ... haha...
Data's intact at least! Just needs a new motherboard. I'll patch it up.
Wait, no. There *is* something wrong.
Locals say the ⟦key|canal east of HS.Swords⟧ is the worst, but I never deployed any there...
I owe you one!
These spare scanners might identify the anomaly. Please install them in the troubled canal. I'll monitor remotely.

options: What happened to "Superstition is the real pollutant"?
They were luminescent underwater... and pulsing.
Seems like they were the "filth" haunting the canals.

scenes.summary: Li Heng scans the canal. Turns out it's just clogged with other disciples' prototypes. Exam season has turned the waterways into a junkyard.

lines.text: You won't believe this... The canal's packed with prototypes!
It's like the worst group project... Everyone's broken oxidizers and filters fighting underwater!
Hah! The "filth" was real. Just half tears, half solder burns from my peers!
Too many aquatic engineering majors, zero lab space. Of course they turned the canals into a backyard testing ground!
...And here I thought I was the innovative one.
Well... Since we're here, might as well fish out all the drowned items and host a lost & found.
I'm gonna apologize to the locals and explain the situation...
By the way, I just noticed the control valve is different here. It lets you move the water level up or down. We can ⟦key|reset the water level⟧ too.
Thanks for helping. I'll begin the scan now.

options: You need to upgrade your waterproofing.

lines.text: No sign of "filth" or "movement"... Hmm, maybe they're just rumors, like that Tianshi disciple said?
Though those devices are a bit concerning...
Yeah, it's too early to tell. Let's head out!
No sign of "filth" or "movement"... Hmm, maybe they're just rumors, like that Tianshi disciple said?
Though those devices are a bit concerning...
Yeah, it's too early to tell. Let's head out!
